description: React component for rendering different types of channel introduction messages in Mattermost, including private, public, direct messages, group messages, and off-topic channels, with interactive buttons and modals.

classes.name: ChannelIntroMessage
classes.description: React component that renders different channel intro messages based on channel type and state, with toggle favorite functionality.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the current channel.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches total user stats if not already available when component mounts.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the appropriate channel intro message based on channel type.

methods.name: createGMIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the intro message UI for group messages, including participant pictures and notification preferences.

methods.name: createDMIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the intro message UI for direct messages, including teammate profile and actions.

methods.name: createOffTopicIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the intro message for off-topic channels with invite and favorite options.

methods.name: createDefaultIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the default intro message for general channels, with creation info and purpose.

methods.name: createStandardIntroMessage
methods.description: Creates the standard intro message for open or private channels, including join info and creation details.

methods.name: createSetHeaderButton
methods.description: Returns a button to set the channel header, if channel is not archived.

methods.name: createFavoriteButton
methods.description: Returns a button to toggle favorite status with appropriate icon and label.

methods.name: createNotificationPreferencesButton
methods.description: Returns a button to open notification preferences modal.
